messages:
Marta (AE): Hey team — new enterprise POC with FinTechX. They need hosted API access + a small Dedicated pool test and a billing project with spend cap and free credits. Can someone help provision? Need keys by EOD Fri.
Devin (Solutions Eng): @Marta send customer org name + expected peak rps and duration. Also: do they need VPC/private deployment or is hosted fine?
Marta (AE): Org: FinTechX Corp. POC window 2 weeks starting Mon. Peak ~120 requests/sec (gen). They want to test a 4-GPU dedicated pool for latency. Hosted ok for initial, but want dedicated perf test.
Rachel (Sales-Eng): Noted. Also they asked about security questionnaire — require KMS integration and audit logs. We should flag Private/VPC if KMS required.
Ben (Billing Ops): For POC billing project we can: 1) create a temporary billing project under our trial org, 2) issue free credit (one-time), 3) set a hard spend cap on project, or 4) issue ephemeral API keys scoped to that project. Which combo do you want?
Marta (AE): Prefer ephemeral keys scoped to project + $5k free credit + hard spend cap at $6k. That ensures they can’t exceed.
Sam (Infra Eng): For Dedicated pool test I need: customer IP allowlist for VPC peering (if private), or confirm they accept shared-hosted-dedicated (no VPC). Also need model, max seq len, and expected concurrency per GPU.
Marta (AE): I'll get those details. Model: 'redwood-004-latency' (recommended). Seq len typical 512. Concurrency target 12 per GPU.
Devin (Solutions Eng): OK. I'll prepare a lightweight config for Dedicated:
```
pool: ft-fintechx-poc
gpus: 4
instance_type: a100-sxm
max_concurrency_per_gpu: 12
quantization: q4_0
rollout: canary(10%)
```
Devin (Solutions Eng): Also: for ephemeral keys we create project and call internal admin endpoint. Example: 
```
POST https://admin.redwood.internal/v1/projects
{ "name": "ft-fintechx-poc", "owner": "marta@redwood.com", "billing_credits": 5000, "spend_cap": 6000 }

POST https://admin.redwood.internal/v1/projects/ft-fintechx-poc/keys
{ "type": "ephemeral", "ttl_hours": 336 }
```
Ben (Billing Ops): That flow is fine. I’ll create the billing project once infra gives green light. Note: ephemeral keys count against project quotas; set quota: tokens/sec = 6000.
Sam (Infra Eng): For VPC peering we need: customer VPC cidr, ASN, and preferred region. If they don’t want peering, we can spin dedicated pool in shared networking with IP-based allowlist. Which do they prefer?
Marta (AE): I'll ask. Also they have a security request: can we provide KMS-backed key for logs? Rachel, is that acceptable for hosted?
Rachel (Sales-Eng): Hosted can integrate with KMS for audit logs in Private. If they need KMS for model inference keys (customer-managed keys) that's Private-only. Ask them what level of control they need.
Marta (AE): Understood — will confirm.
provision-bot: created ticket INFRA-2124 for dedicated pool request, assigned to Sam.
Sam (Infra Eng): I took INFRA-2124. If Marta shares customer network details today I can provision a shared-dedicated pool by tomorrow EOD or VPC peer in ~3 days.
Ben (Billing Ops): Holding until infra confirms. I’ll also prepare the one-time credit journal entry and set spend cap.
Marta (AE): Thanks. I’ll send network details and the signed NDA. Tight timeline but doable. cc @Devin @Rachel
Devin (Solutions Eng): Happy to support the runbook and do verification once keys/pool are live.
Marta (AE): Perfect. Will update thread with the network CIDR and their SSO contact.
provision-bot: INFRA-2124 status updated -> in_progress (sam).
